name: Markus von Leonstein
original_name: マークス・フォン・レオンシュタイン
source:
"Hrgh-- As the future king of Phrygia, backing off like this is unacceptable...!"

- Origin: Phrygia Kingdom
- Birthday: April 22
- Height: 180cm
- Likes: Black tea
- Dislikes: Studying
- Will/Gem: "Harangue: Waning Moon Night Rose Garden" Zillion Rhodonite

A second-year Academia student who also happens to be an inheritor of Phrygia's royal family.
He is receiving daily strict trainings by his accompanying grandfather in order to develop the skills necessary to become the next king.

[Translated from [url=http://cabbage-soft.com/character/]Official Website[/url]]
